2026 battery demand = 1300.4 万辆 × 56 kWh = 13,004,000 × 56 = 728,224,000 kWh = 728.224 GWh

**Step 5: Calculate YoY growth rate**

Growth rate = (728.224 - 596.0) / 596.0 × 100%
= 132.224 / 596.0 × 100%
= 22.185...%
≈ 22.19%
